title: Grateful Dead Live at Henry J. Kaiser Auditorium on 1988-02-13
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (no Dolby) > Audiophile 2496 > Wavelab > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644
source: OTS AUD: Sennheiser MD-441's > patched thru one Sony D5 > Sony WM-D6C > Maxell MX-90's with no Dolby.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures the cold‑dark Kaiser atmosphere with standout Gimme Some Lovin' and The Other One jams, despite unusually short sets.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as a great audience source that conveys the wintry vibe of the Kaiser venue. Reviewers highlight the jam on Gimme Some Lovin' and the Other One > Sat Night as high points, though they note the sets are exceedingly brief. Overall the performance is enjoyable but not enough to earn higher than a mixed rating.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; positive remarks about recording quality and specific jams offset the comment about short sets, leading to an average‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear audience capture that conveys venue atmosphere; no technical flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Exceedingly short sets with a wintry, dark ambience; jams on Gimme Some Lovin' and The Other One are highlighted.
